ByteDance Seedance 2.5: Native 30-Second AI Video, No Stitching Required

Bytedance.com

ByteDance raised the ceiling on AI video generation Tuesday when it announced Seedance 2.5 at the Volcano Engine FORCE conference in Beijing — a model that, the company claims, can generate a single continuous 30-second clip without stitching shorter segments together.
